subject.title: v2026.6.x system prompt bloat causes instruction following degradation on smaller models

question: Which prompt-pressure strategy should OpenClaw own for constrained models that now miss skill triggers or custom protocol precedence after v2026.6 prompt growth?
rationale: The issue cannot be safely reduced to one code fix because the viable paths change prompt/default behavior, skill-loading semantics, and possibly new or existing config surfaces.

options.title: Coordinate A Prompt-Pressure Policy
options.body: Keep this open and design one product-owned policy across lean mode, bootstrap budgets, skill loading, Tool Search, and local-model guidance before implementing defaults or new knobs.

options.title: Fold Into Existing Open Prompt-Pressure Issues
options.body: Close or link this only if maintainers choose a single canonical issue such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/75189 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/90349 and explicitly preserve this issue's v2026.6 skill/protocol evidence there.

options.title: Document Current Workarounds Only
options.body: Treat current `localModelLean`, bootstrap limits, and model selection guidance as the supported answer, accepting that weaker-model instruction-priority failures remain outside core for now.

recommendation.title: Coordinate A Prompt-Pressure Policy
recommendation.body: Keep this open and design one product-owned policy across lean mode, bootstrap budgets, skill loading, Tool Search, and local-model guidance before implementing defaults or new knobs.

likelyOwner.reason: This issue needs a product/default decision, and this handle is tied to prompt/default history and was explicitly mentioned on the issue timeline.
